reserveReview.reviewer: Codex Indigo current indexer reserve review
reserveReview.rationale: Re-opened 2026-09-04. Indigo's public analytics endpoint returned 1,304,791.489011 iUSD of debt on the native ADA branch (the API's empty collateral_asset denotes ADA) and 4,925.589863 iUSD on the NIGHT branch. Koios asset_info reported total iUSD supply of 1,418,834.456586. Indexed CDP debt therefore covers 1,309,717.078874 iUSD, represented as 91.9622% ADA and 0.3472% NIGHT after rounding; the 109,117.377712 iUSD residual is 7.6906%. The API responses do not expose one shared historical ledger point for CDP debt and supply, and the residual may include USDCx/USDM peg-stability or CDP paths not represented in the index, so it remains explicitly unresolved rather than normalized away.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Indigo analytics iUSD CDP index and Koios iUSD supply fetched 2026-09-04; indexed minted debt attributed by collateral branch, with residual retained
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The 109,117.377712 iUSD difference between policy supply and indexed CDP debt is not attributed by a shared snapshot. Indigo mint transactions and validator balances show USDCx/USDM collateral paths, but no current public endpoint reconciles those balances to individual iUSD CDPs or a peg-stability module.
